sources.evaluation: pilot judged_responses.csv (+ manual_review.csv overrides) and results/graded/*.jsonl, labelled by datasets/*.json

limitations: Evaluation scores come from a 6-case pilot (2 easy, 2 moderate, 2 hard); each model x difficulty cell has n=2. Treat rankings as preliminary.
Scores are GPT-5.1 LLM-judge scores (0-4). Human-adjudication columns in benchmark/artifacts/manual_review.csv are empty; filled human scores override judge scores automatically on the next build.
GPT-5.1 judged its own 6 responses (self_judged=True in judged_responses.csv).

Only temporal_comparison (two-image 'what changed?') has graded results. landmark_identification, cross_view_matching, spatial_reasoning and factual_retrieval have no task-specific scores; routing falls back to the general score for them.
One response per model and case at temperature 0; no repetitions, so no variance estimates.
Latency was measured from one client location in October 2026 and includes provider queueing.

pricing.note: Reference price from the OpenRouter listing of the same model; direct OpenAI API pricing is not exposed programmatically. Verify before billing.
